name: AP-1-C attack droid
description: The AP-1-C attack droid (Armored Platform, model 1, command) was a battle droid used by the Imperial Remnant. It was created by Arakyd, makers of the Arakyd Viper. The AP-1-C was armed with a repeating blaster, but more commonly was used, as its name suggests, as a commander for its ally AP-2 and AP-3 attack droids.
